entity_geography.text: . 3 V gV unterrichtet die Vergabestelle auf Verlangen des Bieters unverzüglich, spätestens innerhalb von 15 Tagen nach Eingang des Antrags in Textform nach § 126b des Bürgerlichen Gesetzbuchs jeden Bieter über die Merkmale und Vorteile des erfolgreichen Angebots sowie den Namen des erfolgreichen Bieters. Nach § 39 Abs . 1 VgV übermittelt die Vergabestelle spätestens 30 Tage nach der Vergabe eines öffentlichen Auftrags oder nach dem Abschluss einer Rahmenvereinbarung eine Vergabebekanntmachung mit den Ergebnissen des Vergabeverfahrens an das Amt für Veröffentlichungen der Europ äischen Union. Hier werden auch Name und Anschrift des Wirtschaftsteilnehmers, zu dessen Gunsten der Zuschlag erteilt wurde, veröffentlicht. Im Falle der Einleitung eines Nachprüfungsverfahrens vor der Vergabekammer hat die Vergabestelle nach § 163 Abs. 2 S. 4 GWB die Vergabeakten der Kammer sofort zur Verfügung zu stellen. Der Auftragnehmer hat bei gegebenem Anlass, aber mindestens jährlich, gemäß Artikel 32 Absatz 1 Buchstabe d DSGVO eine Überprüfung, Bewertung und Evaluation der Wirksamkeit der technischen und organisatorischen Maßnahmen zur Gewährleistung der Sicherheit der Verarbeitung durchzuführen. Over the past decade, this ecosystem has expanded organically through project ‑by‑project deployments. As a result, the current environment is characterised by fragmentation, inconsistent branding, duplication of operational and hosting costs, varied technical standards, and increasingly complex governance and content‑management structures. A preliminary mapping exercise conducted by MTA has identified more than thirty (30) digital assets, including consumer‑facing websites, corporate platforms, country‑specific domains (e.g., 14 Unclassified France, Germany, Italy, the UK, Japan, Korea, and others), MICE ‑focused portals, event ‑driven microsites, and international representative sites. These range from high ‑traffic multilingual portals such as VisitMalta.com to legacy campaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal syst

mpaign sites, temporary market blogs, outdated or abandoned domains, and internal systems supporting media management, CRM, B2B services, and training. Social media channels and API ‑based integrations further contribute to the broader content flow and technical landscape. MTA’s strategic direction is to consolidate this extensive and heterogeneous digital landscape under a unified and coherent platform centred around VisitMalta.com. The objective is to improve user experience, reinforce consistent brand representation across all markets, streamline content and technical governance, and reduce long‑term operational, maintenance, and hosting costs. To support this strategic shift, MTA requires a comprehensive Web Environment Analysis and Requirements Definition Exercise. It shall assess the current ecosystem in full, map underlying systems and content flows, identify consolidation and rationalisation opportunities, and define the technical, functional, governance, integration, and procurement requirements. The findings will directly inform the preparation of a public tender, ensuring that the future solution is robust, scalable, interoperable, secure, and aligned with MTA’s long‑term digital transformation strategy. 1.6 - Related Programmes and Donor Activities T

Ultimately, the contract will ensure that MTA has the foundations required to implement a future-proof digital platform offering consistent branding, improved user experience, enhanced operational efficiency, and strengthened international visibility. 2.2 - Specific Objectives The objectives of this contract [which are not necessarily those of the project] are as follows: 1. To carry out a complete and validated analysis of MTA’s current digital ecosystem This objective focuses on discovering, mapping, auditing, and assessing all MTA digital assets, including domains, subdomains, microsites, hosting environments, CMS platforms, integrations, 15 Unclassified SEO structures, and compliance obligations. The Consultant must identify shadow sites, legacy components, security vulnerabilities, and operational inefficiencies to establish an authoritative baseline for consolidation. The Consultant shall categorise each asset using a Retain / Migrate / Redesign / Retire model. This objective ensures that strategic, technical, functional, and governance considerations guide which elements of the current web estate are preserved, redesig ned, consolidated, or phased out. 2.
